anya: Postmortem follow-up: consolidate owners/timelines for vendor outage mitigations. TL;DR: pick MVM and owners.

diego: I'll own cloud gating + health probes. Goal: staging prototype in 7 days, canary in next sprint. assigning: diego.

sara: taking model-registry durability + local cache. I'll draft runbook + tests by Fri. assigning: sara.

tim: I'll cover auth provider resilience: SDK circuit breaker + fallback verifier. prototype this week. assigning: tim.

lucy: ops will create composite alerts and on-call steps. calendar playbook entry by Wed. assigning: lucy.

anya: MVM proposal (14d): cloud gating (diego), registry cache (sara), basic SDK cb (tim). confirm?

diego: confirm. plan snippet:
```
- region health: 3 failed probes -> avoid routing
- traffic shift: 2m canary, then 30m holds for larger shifts
- DNS TTLs: 60s canary, 300s general
```

sara: confirm. cache snippet:
```
- artifact cache soft-ttl 8m
- stale-while-revalidate to serve during registry spikes
- instrument registry latency and error-rate
```

tim: auth snippet:
```
- SDK CB: open after 3 errs / 4s
- verification-only fallback token in KMS
- daily smoke that exercises fallback
```

ci-bot: diego triggered infra/health-gating:staging deploy at 2205679000 status: success.

anya: nice. next: update postmortem tracker with owners, deadlines, acceptance criteria. I'll run 15m weekly check-ins until done.

lucy: invite sent for weekly "Dependency Mitigations".

diego: will PR infra scripts and test harness.

sara: will open registry cache PR and attach benchmark results.

tim: will submit SDK PR behind feature flag and ping platform reviewers.

anya: thanks all. If blockers surface, ping this thread. Closing for now. :v:
